mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital toward equities.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.5% but 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production below 104 and housing starts below 1080 signal broad economic contraction, triggering reduced corporate output and profit expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 104 and HOUST < 1080 but 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), rising inflation pressures prompt aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% but 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payroll growth above 100,000 jobs per month strengthens consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic momentum builds.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 100,000 but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1,000 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand for housing, reducing construction activity and retail spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1000 but 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) indicate a liquidity trap where monetary policy loses effectiveness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.5% but 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO < 100), declining industrial production signals manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 but 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
